channel.title: Mitchel Pawirodinomo
channel.description: Writing on infrastructure, Go tooling and side projects.

item.title: Ditching Docker Desktop: Lightweight Containers with Colima and Portainer
item.description: Docker Desktop on macOS eats gigabytes of RAM just sitting idle. Here is how I replaced it with Colima for the container runtime and Portainer for the UI.

item.title: Building CryptoWatcher: Bringing macOS Stocks Widgets into the Terminal with Go
item.description: I wanted the glanceability of macOS Stocks widgets inside my tmux session. Here is how I built CryptoWatcher in Go using Bubble Tea, Lipgloss, high-definition Braille line charts, and composite multi-feed asset routing.

item.title: Building Cashly: Architecting a Multi-Asset Financial Intelligence Engine & AI Copilot
item.description: Why I stopped using third-party budget apps and built a self-hosted financial operating system with a Go daemon, Next.js 14, automated bank email ingestion, dynamic cashflow models, and an autonomous AI copilot.

item.title: Why I Built bcron: Fixing Everything That Annoys Me About Crontab
item.description: I got tired of silent cron failures, digging through syslog, and guessing whether background jobs were still running. Here is how I built bcron in Go.

item.title: Scraping 8 Surinamese Banks Without Losing My Mind: The ForexSU Story
item.description: Why I built ForexSU to track foreign currency rates across Suriname, and how to write resilient web scrapers that survive constant HTML breaking changes.
